objective: Re-execute core formalization and foundation comparison beyond carrier cardinality two without promoting bounded observations.

bounds.axis_policy: Each unary and binary relation interpretation is exhaustively enumerated independently at every carrier size 0..4; cross-products of all signature relations are not enumerated.
bounds.foundation_benchmark_bound: The frozen 19-benchmark executable suite is rerun unchanged so comparison changes cannot be attributed to benchmark replacement.
bounds.resource_limit: Deterministic single-process enumeration; no solver, oracle, network, probabilistic sampling, or unrecorded pruning.

nonclaims: no inference beyond the explicit finite bounds
